name: Accessibility Auditor
author: opencode-core
description: Audit HTML/JSX code against WCAG 2.1 guidelines and provide accessible ARIA code fixes.

name: Tailwind CSS Converter
author: opencode-core
description: Convert raw CSS or inline styles into clean, idiomatic Tailwind CSS utility classes.

name: SEO & Metadata Builder
author: opencode-core
description: Generate complete HTML meta tags, Open Graph, Twitter Cards, and JSON-LD structured data.

name: Terraform Module Builder
author: opencode-core
description: Draft modular, reusable Infrastructure-as-Code Terraform modules for cloud infrastructure.

name: Serverless Function Generator
author: opencode-core
description: Scaffold lightweight serverless handlers for Cloudflare Workers or AWS Lambda with standard CORS and error handling.

name: GraphQL Schema Designer
author: opencode-core
description: Design GraphQL type definitions, query/mutation schemas, and resolver boilerplate code.

name: Pandas Data Cleaner
author: opencode-core
description: Generate Python Pandas scripts to handle missing values, drop duplicates, and normalize column data types.

name: Chart Config Generator
author: opencode-core
description: Map raw JSON datasets into ready-to-use chart configuration objects (Chart.js, Recharts, or ECharts).

name: RAG Chunking Evaluator
author: opencode-core
description: Analyze document structures to recommend optimal chunking strategies and overlap ratios for RAG pipelines.

name: Structured Output Enforcer
author: opencode-core
description: Convert unstructured LLM output into validated JSON adhering to strict Zod or JSON Schema rules.

name: Mermaid Diagrammer
author: opencode-core
description: Convert code logic, database structures, or system architectures into valid Mermaid.js visual diagrams.

name: i18n Locale Extractor
author: opencode-core
description: Extract hardcoded UI text strings into structured internationalization JSON translation files.

name: Regex Builder & Explainer
author: opencode-core
description: Construct complex regular expressions based on pattern requirements with step-by-step logic breakdown.

name: Webhook Handler Generator
author: opencode-core
description: Draft secure webhook receiver endpoints complete with cryptographic signature verification (Stripe, GitHub, Midtrans).

name: Cron Schedule Parser
author: opencode-core
description: Translate natural language time rules into valid 5-part or 6-part Cron schedule expressions.

name: Design Pattern Implementer
author: opencode-core
description: Refactor code to apply object-oriented design patterns (Factory, Strategy, Observer, Decorator, Adapter) cleanly.

name: Async Concurrency Handler
author: opencode-core
description: Implement async/await workflows, promise pools, worker threads, or goroutines while preventing race conditions.

name: Data Structure Optimizer
author: opencode-core
description: Analyze algorithm time/space complexity (Big O) and refactor logic using optimal data structures (Heaps, Tries, Hash Maps).

name: Memory Leak Debugger
author: opencode-core
description: Identify and resolve unmanaged memory leaks, event listener leaks, and circular references across runtimes.

name: State Management Architect
author: opencode-core
description: Implement clean application state management patterns (Zustand, Redux Toolkit, Pinia) with atomic state updates.

name: Error Class Hierarchy Builder
author: opencode-core
description: Create domain-specific custom exception classes with standardized error codes, HTTP statuses, and metadata payloads.

name: Caching Strategy Implementer
author: opencode-core
description: Implement Cache-Aside, Write-Through, and TTL-based caching logic using Redis or in-memory LRU caches.

name: Rate Limiter Middleware
author: opencode-core
description: Build API rate-limiting middleware using Token Bucket or Sliding Window algorithms.

name: Dependency Injection Wiring
author: opencode-core
description: Decouple code modules using Inversion of Control (IoC) containers and explicit interface abstractions.

name: JWT Token Rotator
author: opencode-core
description: Implement secure short-lived access token renewal and refresh token rotation with revocation blacklisting.

name: Pagination Cursor Builder
author: opencode-core
description: Build cursor-based and keyset pagination handlers for database queries and API endpoints.

name: WebSocket Realtime Handler
author: opencode-core
description: Implement WebSocket connection lifecycles, ping/pong heartbeats, reconnect logic, and event broadcasting.

name: Type Definition Generator
author: opencode-core
description: Convert untyped JavaScript, Python dicts, or raw JSON payloads into strict TypeScript interfaces or Type Hint annotations.

name: CLI Tool Scaffolder
author: opencode-core
description: Scaffold interactive command-line interface tools with argument parsing, flags, spinners, and help menus.

name: Regex Builder & Parser
author: opencode-core
description: Construct ReDoS-safe regular expressions and string parser logic for complex input string extraction.

name: Cmd Sanitizer
author: opencode-core
description: Static linter over command strings before execution. Detects and rewrites unsafe Win32/PowerShell 5.1 patterns: bare && chaining, unquoted spaced paths, $? vs $LASTEXITCODE confusion, UTF-16 pipe corruption, and timeout-kill indeterminacy. Emits sanitized command + guard boilerplate.

name: Verify Orchestrator
author: opencode-core
description: Auto-discovers project verification surface (test/lint/typecheck configs), runs the minimal verification suite, and gates every completion claim on machine-parsed exit codes and assertion output. Returns UNVERIFIED rather than silent on discovery failure.

name: Context Bank
author: opencode-core
description: Materializes a structured CONTEXT_BANK.md + JSON file that captures verified file paths, decided invariants, active TODOs, and open risks, allowing subagents and repeated sessions to reload a lean current snapshot instead of decaying transcript memory.

name: Dep Map
author: opencode-core
description: Builds a persistent dependency graph (`dep-graph.json`) by scanning `import`/`require`/`include` patterns across the codebase. Before any edit it lists the blast radius of consumers for the target symbol; after the edit it re-verifies no orphaned references exist.

name: Spec Loop Closer
author: opencode-core
description: Forces every user requirement through a 1:1 mapping to a checkable assertion (grep-able token, executable test, or numeric threshold) before implementation begins. Blocks "done" until each assertion has a machine-runnable check.

name: Regression Sentinel
author: opencode-core
description: Before each new task in a long session, re-runs the last N passing checkpoints captured by verify-orchestrator as a smoke suite, catching regressions caused by recent edits before they compound.

name: Memory Journal
author: opencode-core
description: Cross-session ledger at `~/.opencode/memory/*.md`: appends decisions/rejections/root-causes during a session; on session start, diffs against the live transcript so the agent stops re-litigating settled decisions.

name: Output Trust Check
author: opencode-core
description: Wraps every truncating tool call: when output is truncated/byte-capped, refuses to decide on the truncated portion and automatically requests the tail window or a targeted grep. Flags encoding anomalies (UTF-16 NULs, BOMs) as suspect.

name: Subagent Evidence
author: opencode-core
description: Dispatch-time contract for explore agents: return only observations each with a `file:line` citation and raw excerpt; inference must be explicitly tagged `[INFERRED]`. Post-dispatch, I sample-cite — verify ≥2 citations per summary myself before trusting conclusions.

name: Schema Sync
author: opencode-core
description: Before multi-step toolkit workflows, pings the live tool (via schema-style endpoints / search tools) and diffs against my cached schema; on mismatch, rewrites the workflow plan, never the cached assumptions silently.
